name: React
covers: Linter-equivalent to eslint-plugin-react 7.37.5 and react-hooks 7.1.1, for well-built components and hooks. Also Rerail's own practice rules.

rules.title: eslint-plugin-react button-has-type: Disallow usage of `button` elements without an explicit `type` attribute
eslint-plugin-react-hooks error-boundaries: Validates usage of error boundaries instead of try/catch for errors in child components
eslint-plugin-react-hooks exhaustive-deps: Verifies the list of dependencies for Hooks like useEffect and similar
eslint-plugin-react-hooks globals: Validates against assignment/mutation of globals during render
eslint-plugin-react-hooks immutability: Validates against mutating props, state, and other values that are immutable
eslint-plugin-react-hooks purity: Validates that components/hooks are pure by checking known-impure functions
eslint-plugin-react-hooks refs: Validates correct usage of refs, not reading/writing during render
eslint-plugin-react-hooks rules-of-hooks: Enforces the Rules of Hooks
eslint-plugin-react-hooks set-state-in-effect: Validates against calling setState synchronously in an effect
eslint-plugin-react-hooks set-state-in-render: Validates against setting state during render
eslint-plugin-react-hooks static-components: Validates that components are static, not recreated every render
eslint-plugin-react iframe-missing-sandbox: Enforce sandbox attribute on iframe elements
eslint-plugin-react jsx-key: Disallow missing `key` props in iterators/collection literals
eslint-plugin-react jsx-no-comment-textnodes: Disallow comments from being inserted as text nodes
eslint-plugin-react jsx-no-constructed-context-values: Disallows JSX context provider values from taking values that will cause needless rerenders
eslint-plugin-react jsx-no-duplicate-props: Disallow duplicate properties in JSX
eslint-plugin-react jsx-no-leaked-render: Disallow problematic leaked values from being rendered
eslint-plugin-react jsx-no-script-url: Disallow usage of `javascript:` URLs
eslint-plugin-react jsx-no-target-blank: Disallow `target="_blank"` attribute without `rel="noreferrer"`
eslint-plugin-react jsx-no-undef: Disallow undeclared variables in JSX
eslint-plugin-react no-access-state-in-setstate: Disallow when this.state is accessed within setState
eslint-plugin-react no-array-index-key: Disallow usage of Array index in keys
eslint-plugin-react no-children-prop: Disallow passing of children as props
eslint-plugin-react no-danger: Disallow usage of dangerous JSX properties
eslint-plugin-react no-danger-with-children: Disallow when a DOM element is using both children and dangerouslySetInnerHTML
eslint-plugin-react no-deprecated: Disallow usage of deprecated methods
eslint-plugin-react no-did-mount-set-state: Disallow usage of setState in componentDidMount
eslint-plugin-react no-did-update-set-state: Disallow usage of setState in componentDidUpdate
eslint-plugin-react no-direct-mutation-state: Disallow direct mutation of this.state
eslint-plugin-react no-find-dom-node: Disallow usage of findDOMNode
eslint-plugin-react no-is-mounted: Disallow usage of isMounted
eslint-plugin-react no-object-type-as-default-prop: Disallow usage of referential-type variables as default param in functional component
eslint-plugin-react no-render-return-value: Disallow usage of the return value of ReactDOM.render
eslint-plugin-react no-string-refs: Disallow using string references
eslint-plugin-react no-unescaped-entities: Disallow unescaped HTML entities from appearing in markup
eslint-plugin-react no-unknown-property: Disallow usage of unknown DOM property
eslint-plugin-react no-unsafe: Disallow usage of unsafe lifecycle methods
eslint-plugin-react no-unstable-nested-components: Disallow creating unstable components inside components
eslint-plugin-react self-closing-comp: Disallow extra closing tags for components without children

eslint-plugin-react void-dom-elements-no-children: Disallow void DOM elements (e.g. ``, `
`) from receiving children
React practice: useCallback whose result only built-in elements or direct calls use
React practice: Hook dependency rebuilt on every render
React practice: Navigation, analytics or dispatch called during render
React practice: Effect writes a .then result to state without a stale-result guard
React practice: Query cache update in a mutate call's own callbacks
React practice: Mount ref set false in cleanup and never set back to true
React practice: useMemo around a value or a cheap expression
React practice: Store selector returns a new object or array
React practice: Request in an effect in a file that uses a data library
React practice: Value that reads nothing from the component, built every render
React practice: Run-once lifecycle hook reading component values
